title: Length exactly 30 m with one wheelchair space
why: 'Less than 30 m' excludes 30: a 30 m unit is in the 2-space row.

spec.name: Length exactly 30 m with one wheelchair space

wheelchair_spaces.rationale: Table 5 of point 4.2.2.2(1): 'Less than 30 m' is 1 space, '30 to 205 metres' is 2. 30 is in the second row, so 1 < 2.
